name: Aberdeen (northwest Indiana parkland, high summer)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2. The Course at Aberdeen, Valparaiso IN (Hurdzan, 1997): Kentucky bluegrass and bent turf in high summer, a touch bluer than the New England themes; lush blue-green bluegrass rough (F0-F2); bright tan-white bunker sand; dark, tea-tinted wetland ponds (W0-W2). Trees in assets-src/trees_aberdeen.py: bur oak, sugar maple, silver maple / cottonwood at the wetland edges, blue spruce and white pine by the houses. Course chat 2026-10-31, from the setting (no club imagery). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
